title: The state of decay of "AI"? GM's in WoW

posts.cooked:
I had an alliance GDKP AQ20- on whitemane - on CLASSIC ERA, seemed to be standard GDKP, as you know that’s the only way to get a quick easy hassle-free raid with the state of the server and economy these days.

Then the Leader ninja’d the gold at the end of it. A certain bad actor- full t2 paladin dwarf healer with a hard to pronounce name rhyming with penguin, a conspicuous name nonetheless…

The raid complains and infact a few have knowledge that this guy has done this before and friends/guildies have heard of him ninja’ing a ZG GDKP loot the day before, obviously not his first time based on the raid’s and guilds and trade / LFG world comments…

So a few of us remaining put in a GM complaint and the response a day later entails:

Greetings, “insert name here!”
This is Game Master “insert name here”.

I am very sorry to hear what has happened. This is definitely not acceptable and is not how players should behave around each other. I have taken steps from my side to investigate the offender: and to take the appropriate actions.

However I bring to your attention our stance regarding GDKP, which you can see here

GDKP in Season of Discovery Season of Discovery
Starting with Phase 2 of Season of Discovery, we are going to experiment with a policy change: We will no longer support or allow GDKP or “gold bid” raids and dungeons in Season of Discovery. We’ve seen many questions about this policy change, so please read on for our answers and more information. What is GDKP and why is it being restricted in Season of Discovery? GDKP is a loot system some players use that essentially allows all loot to be purchased in a dungeon or raid using gold rather tha…

As a side note, let me tell you that we are thankful to you for being part of our universe!

“A bunch of random scriggly text to convey some sort of message” - Maybe a personal note so I don’t want to indemnify - maybe a bot automated message who knows.

Wishing you an excellent time and exciting, thrilling adventures!
Kind Regards,
Game Master “insert name here”

I do hope they actually did look into the matter but when I am playing on CLASSIC ERA and as such GDKP hasn’t been banned and has become the only real way to play the game, I am only disheartened that either the GM has such little time to actually read the player complaint and actually acknowledge the player / server I am on…

Or the GM’s have been replaced by AI BOTs that actually don’t understand the clientele complaints and blizzard is cost-cutting to the point I am not sure if I want to continue playing the game if people can get away with such terrible deeds when I’m just trying to play the game through GDKP as the community now seems to accept as the norm.
